candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly in response to terms related to psychiatric conditions and psychological disorders.
These tokens represent common German words, prefixes, and grammatical components, particularly focusing on numbers and relational terms.
These tokens represent common German verb roots and noun-forming suffixes used to create compound words and derivations.
The tokens represent psychoactive substances and cannabis-related terms, alongside some unrelated proper nouns and noise.
This vector is related to common German auxiliary, modal, and copular verbs in various conjugated forms.
This vector represents common German derivational suffixes and morphological endings used for adjectives, verbs, and abstract nouns.
This vector is related to sequential integers within the low positive number range.
These tokens represent common German prepositional adverbs, locative pronouns, and related function words starting with or containing typical prefix-adverb structures.
This vector represents common German grammatical words and conjunctions used to structure sentences.
This feature vector represents the concept of legality, law, and related lawful or unlawful terms.
